headline: Lattice Semiconductor CEO Ford Tamer Acquires $1M in Company Stock
summary: Lattice Semiconductor CEO Ford Tamer acquired $1 million worth of company stock in an open market transaction.
why: Insider purchases by top executives are frequently viewed by market participants as a signal of management confidence in the company's valuation and prospects.

impacts.name: Lattice Semiconductor
impacts.why: Open-market stock purchases by chief executives can signal positive internal sentiment about company equity.
